stories.title: Dağları delip yan yana 2 tünel açacaklar: Her biri 14 kilometre olacak

en.title: They will pierce the mountains and open 2 tunnels side by side: Each will be 14 kilometres
en.summary: A major transport project between Argentina and Chile that has been planned for years has been revived. Two tunnels, each 14 kilometres long, are planned to be constructed beneath the Andes Mountains to connect the two countries.

stories.title: Bakırköy’de boşaltılan binanın çatısı alev alev yandı

en.title: Roof of evacuated building in Bakırköy caught fire
en.summary: A fire broke out on the roof of a 4-storey building in Bakırköy that was evacuated as part of urban renewal. Firefighters extinguished the flames, and police launched an investigation.

en.title: Driver dispute disrupted traffic
en.summary: A dispute between a taxi driver and another vehicle driver in Istanbul's Esenyurt district quickly escalated and disrupted traffic in the area.

stories.title: YENİ Parti Samsun’da sahaya indi: 'Bu karanlık iktidar gidecek'

en.title: YENİ Party took to the field in Samsun: 'This dark government will be gone'
en.summary: YENİ Party members attended the opening of their district headquarters in Samsun. A party deputy stated the party's position on upcoming elections and governance.

stories.title: Ersun Yanal'dan Fenerbahçe eleştirisi: 'Prangalar zihne vurulmuş'

en.title: Ersun Yanal's criticism of Fenerbahçe: 'Shackles have been driven into the mind'
en.summary: Fenerbahçe drew 0-0 away against Gaziantep FK in the 5th week of the Super League. Former Fenerbahçe coach Ersun Yanal commented on the team's performance.

stories.title: 2 gündür haber alınamıyordu; fındık bahçesinde cansız bedeni bulundu

en.title: No news for 2 days; lifeless body found in hazelnut orchard
en.summary: A 35-year-old man missing for two days in Düzce's Yığılca district was found dead in a hazelnut orchard.

stories.title: 'Yeni bir rezaleti daha ortaya çıkardık' diyerek duyurdu... YENİ Partili Yavuzyılmaz: 'Türkiye’ye faturası yıllık en az 100 Milyon Dolar olacak!'

en.title: 'We uncovered another scandal' - YENİ Party's Yavuzyılmaz: 'Turkey's bill will be at least 100 Million Dollars annually!'
en.summary: YENİ Party MP Deniz Yavuzyılmaz stated that Turkey lost a World Trade Organization case involving Chinese automobiles, estimating the annual cost at minimum 100 million dollars. He called for the trade minister to file an appeal by the September 26, 2026 deadline.

stories.title: 2 gündür haber alınamıyordu: Fındık bahçesinde ölü bulundu

en.title: No news for 2 days: Dead body found in hazelnut orchard
en.summary: A person missing for two days in Yığılca district of Düzce was discovered dead in a hazelnut orchard.

en.title: 2 suspects arrested in Dilek Kalkan murder case
en.summary: A skeleton found in a riverbed in Bismil district of Diyarbakır in 2014 has been identified as belonging to Dilek Kalkan. Two suspects have been arrested in connection with the case.

stories.title: Edirne’de apartman dairesinde 10 kaçak göçmen yakalandı: Aralarında çocuklar da var

en.title: 10 illegal migrants apprehended in apartment in Edirne: Children among them
en.summary: Police conducted an operation in Edirne and found 10 undocumented migrants in an apartment, including children. The migrants were handed over to the provincial immigration office after processing.

stories.title: Edirne’de apartman dairesinde 10 kaçak göçmen yakalandı

en.title: 10 illegal migrants apprehended in apartment in Edirne
en.summary: During a police operation in Edirne, authorities found 10 undocumented migrants in an apartment, among them children.

stories.title: Cesedinin kimliği 12 yıl sonra belirlendi: Dilek Kalkan'ın ölümüne ilişkin 2 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: Identity of remains determined after 12 years: 2 suspects arrested in Dilek Kalkan death
en.summary: A skeleton discovered in a riverbed in Bismil, Diyarbakır in 2014 has been identified as Dilek Kalkan after new examinations. Two of seven detained suspects were arrested while five were released under judicial supervision.

stories.title: Serdar Dursun: Fenerbahçe kadrosunda bir yetersizlik var

en.title: Serdar Dursun: There is a deficiency in Fenerbahçe's squad
en.summary: An experienced footballer from Gaziantep Football Club stated that Fenerbahçe lacks sufficient player depth in their squad. He noted that securing one point against a top team was beneficial.

stories.title: Trump Jr. ve eşinden Rus oligark itirafı

en.title: Trump Jr. and wife acknowledge Russian oligarch admission
en.summary: Donald Trump Jr. and his wife Bettina confirmed that portions of their wedding celebrations in May were financed by Umar Kremlev, a Russian oligarch with close ties to Vladimir Putin.

stories.title: CENTCOM: İran'ın tanker iddiası doğru değil

en.title: CENTCOM: Iran's tanker claim is not true
en.summary: The U.S. Central Command disputed Iran's Revolutionary Guards claim that a super tanker struck a mine in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Suudi Veliaht Prensi Selman yarın Mısır'ı ziyaret edecek

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince Selman to visit Egypt tomorrow
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Selman will meet with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi during a visit to Egypt.

stories.title: Sanayisizleşme tartışmasına TÜSİAD da katıldı: “Yeni bir sanayi için 15 yıllık strateji şart”

en.title: TUSIAD Joins Deindustrialization Debate: "15-Year Strategy Required for New Industry"
en.summary: TUSIAD's chairman stated that Turkey needs a new industrial strategy spanning 10-15 years that is clear, long-term, concrete and closely monitored, emphasizing the importance of such economic plans for addressing current needs and future prospects.
